checks.name: Unique root closure and recorded source membership
Every selected event, cumulative epoch, metadata field, and private prefix matches
Manifest arithmetic and time boundaries match existing accounting helpers
Earlier shared epoch boundaries and hashes are contained in the new measurement
Prompt count and exact new shaping prompt match parser rules
Research Markdown paths and counts match HEAD
Methodology and shaping prompts match committed bytes at the freeze
Frontmatter matches the frozen manifest exactly
Rendered article and transparency page show the frozen footprint
Every rendered prompt preserves the complete selected message
Article title, canonical URL, original date, and content remain intact

limitations: No production SQL or interactive browser check. Private log contents are excluded. Build and release checks occur after the frozen usage boundary.
